0.title: Find the fours
0.text: The table is full of words. Four at a time have something in common. Pick them and tap Submit group.

1.title: Every group is a different challenge
1.text: Colour and symbol show the difficulty, from easy ● to the toughest ★. Watch out for tricky words that seem to fit elsewhere too.

2.title: Attempts, hints and points
2.text: You have 4 attempts. Get three out of four right and the game will tell you. Hints cost points; speed and bravery (solving a harder group before an easier one) earn extra.
